title: Sparkly lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <path d='M38 32 Q50 14 62 32' fill='none' stroke='#c98b3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
